༄༅:gsang chen thugs kyi sgrub pa las thugs sgrub hūm̐ gi phrin las zab mo rig 'dzin rgod gyi ldem 'phru can gyis gter nas spyan drangs pa'o:

tei:div.tei:p: "!#༄༅: gsang chen thugs kyi sgrub pa las thugs sgrub hūm̐ gi phrin las zab mo rig 'dzin rgod gyi ldem 'phru can gyis gter nas spyan drangs pa'o:

thugs dam lha la phyag 'tshal lo: bdag 'dra pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis: lnga brgya tha ma shar ba'i tshe: ri bo bkra bzang shar 'dabs su: las can sbas pa'i rnal 'byor pa: rgod kyi ldem 'phru can zhig 'byung: de phyir nga yi thugs sgrub bzhag: tshe sgrub lcags kyi sdong po yin: nor sgrub rin chen spungs pa yin: sde brgyad 'dul ba'i gnyen po yin: sgrub chen bka' brgyad 'dus pa yin: pad+ma 'byung gnas snying thig yin: mkha' 'gro rnams kyi snying khrag yin: kun bzang thugs kyi dgongs pa yin: las can bu yi dngos grub yin: nga yi rjes 'jug rnal 'byor pa: man ngag 'di dang 'phrad pa'i tshe: brtson 'grus drag pos bar chad spang: nyams len drag pos dngos grub thob: the tshom spongs la sgrub pa mdzod: bu khyod yi dam 'di la mdzod: bdag dang zhal mjal lung ston nges: e ma ho: 'di nyid sgrub pa'i rnal 'byor pas: dben pa'i gnas su maṇ+ḍal bsham: mdun du pad+ma nga yi sku: rab gnas ldan pa bzhugs su gsol: thugs sgrub sems la longs spyod phyir: sgrub rdzas mchod gtor bshams mi 'tshal: spyan drangs mchod bstod bskul mi dgos: dkyil 'khor gsum gyi sgrub thabs bya: de la bsnyen pa'i rtags rdzogs nas: dngos grub blang ba'i cho ga bya: mchod pa spyan gzigs sna tshogs bsham: thugs sgrub phrin las ting 'dzin ni: hūm̐: dang po rang nyid dben pa'i gnas su 'dug: phyi nang snod bcud snang ba thams cad kun: rang rig sems las byung ba'i cho 'phrul te: sems nyid dngos po gzung 'dzin bral ba'i ngang: de ltar rtogs na bgegs rnams rang sar grol: raṃ yaṃ khaṃ: hūm̐: de nyid ngang las skad cig dran rdzogs su: 'jigs byed chen po rdo rje drag po rtsal: bskal pa'i me 'bar rdo rje'i tshwa tshwa 'phro: 'jig rten thams cad rmangs nas ldeg cing 'khrug: bdud dang dam sri bgegs rigs brlag par byed: oṃ gha gha ghā ta ya ghā ta ya:

sarba duṣ+ṭān mā ra ya phaṭa: kī li kī la ya: sarba pā paṃ hūm̐: badz+ra dhā ra ā dz+nyā pa ya ti: kā ya wā ka tsit+ta hrī: badz+ra kī li kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭa: hūm̐: dus gsum bde gshegs mkha' 'gro dam can rnams: ting 'dzin rtse gcig dad pas spyan drangs nas: bskal pa dpag med dus nas da lta'i bar: dug lnga'i dbang gyur ngan song gsum gyi las: lus ngag yid gsum sdig sgrib mthol lo bshags: badz+ra sa ma ya hūm̐ dza: byin dbab pa ni: hūm̐: bdag nyid sdig sgrib dag pa'i phung po la: lha rnams dgyes shing 'od zer stong gsum gang: bdag la thim pas yi dam lhar gyur te: sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub thob pa yis: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub byin chen 'beb: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: bdud rtsi mchod pa byin rlabs ni: hūm̐: bdag las 'od 'phros bhan+dha'i gzhal yas khang: g.yas g.yon thabs dang shes rab phyag rgya las: rigs lnga yab yum sbyor mdzad byang chub sems: bdud rtsi mu tig dkar po char ltar babs: snod bcud thams cad bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshos gang: hūm̐ oṃ swā āṃḥhā: oṃ āḥhūm̐: ma hā sarba pañca a mṛta hūm̐ hrīḥthā: hūm̐: mtheb srin sbyar bas rta mgrin yum dang bcas: bdud rtsi 'khyil zhing dngos grub ster mdzad lha: bdag la reg pas dam tshig nyams grib dag: rdzas la gtor bas ma dag skyon rnams sbyangs: bgegs la phog pas bdud dang dam sri bskrad: hrīḥm: oṃ badz+ra yak+sha kro dha hūm̐: gtor ma byin brlab ni: hūm̐: snod kyi 'jig rten dur khrod khog pa ru: snying khrag sha rus chu ser nyon mongs lnga: rnam dag ye shes lnga dang 'dod yon drug: bcud kyi 'jig rten lha mo drug gis khengs: dam rdzas gtor ma'i mchod pa byin gyis brlabs: oṃ āḥhūm̐ ma hā ba liṃ ta te dzo ba liṃ ta ba la ba te gu h+ya sa ma ya hūm̐ hrīḥthā: rak+ta byin rlabs ni: hūm̐: bhan+dha 'bar ba rak+ta dmar gyi snod:

khams gsum 'khor ba'i rgyu ni 'dod chags te: rnam shes tshogs brgyad 'dus pa'i rtsa chen khrag: rak+ta chos nyid skye ba med pa las: gsang ba yum gyi thig le bde ba'i ngang: ma hā rak+ta maṇ+ḍa la hūm̐: phyi mchod byin brlab ni: hūm̐: ar+ghaṃ me tog bdug spos mar me dang: dri chab phyi yi mchod pa rnam pa lnga: yid 'ong mdzes pa'i lha mo lnga rnams kyis: rnam dag gtsang mar sbyar te bsnams nas kyang: yi dam lha dang mkha' 'gro mchod pa'i rdzas: oṃ āḥdhū pū ā ga nai hūm̐: de bzhin nyid kyi ting nge 'dzin ni: hūm̐: 'di ltar sems kyi rtsal snang ma 'gags pa'i: sna tshogs snang ba 'di ni ye shes te: snang ba'i dus na ngo bo stong pa'i ngang: chos kyi dbyings nyid spros dang bral bar gnas: dbyer med byang chub sems ni bde ba che: oṃ ma hā shūn+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā ba āt+ma ko3 haṃ: kun tu snang ba'i ting nge 'dzin ni: hūm̐: de ltar ma rtogs 'khrul pa'i sems can rnams: snying rje chen po byams pa'i ting 'dzin gyis: rang rig 'od zer kha dog lnga dang ldan: gsal 'tsher snang ba ma 'gag dwangs pa la: ngo bo brtse ba'i snying rje chen por bsgom: dharma dhā tu maṇ+ḍa la hūm̐: rgyu'i ting nge 'dzin ni: hūm̐: de las 'od lnga 'dus pa'i yi ge ni: hūm̐ chen sngon po 'bar ba nyi zla bzhin: snang stong dbyer med ngang las gsal bar shar: skar chen thang la bab pa'i tshul bzhin du: 'bras bu rgyu yi yi ge hūm̐ du shar: bo dhi tsit+ta maṇ+ḍa la hūm̐: 'byung ba rim brtsegs ni: yi ge hūm̐ las hūm̐ lnga 'phros pa las: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: gangs la thigs pa babs pa bzhin du chags: de las 'od 'phros 'byung ba chen po lnga: 'og gzhi dbang chen gzhal yas gsal bar bsgom: ye shes lnga dang yum lnga rnam dag klong: hūm̐: nam mkha' mthing nag gru gsum brdal ba la: rlung nag rdo rje rgya gram rab tu g.yos: me dpung bskal pa dus mtha'i me ltar 'bar:

rak+ta'i rba klong rgya mtsho'i klong ltar 'khyil: keng rus chen po ri rab lhun sdug brjid: e yaṃ raṃ ra su keṃ: de las gzhal yas khang bskyed pa ni: hūm̐: rgyu yi yi ge nyid las 'od 'phros pas: snang ba snod kyi 'jig rten thams cad kun: bdag gi gzugs kyi phung po gzhal yas khang: tsit+ta'i ga 'u rin chen pho brang mdzes: rtsa chen rtsa phran ka gdung rgyan dang bcas: bhan+dha'i rtsig pa nang khrol drwa bar ldan: rnam shes tshogs brgyad gzer gyis rab tu bsdams: gsal byed mig gnyis nyi zla'i mthong khung la: steng 'og rgyu lam bzhi la sgo bzhi gnas: byang chub sems las kun 'byung gzhal yas khang: bh+rūm̐ bi shwa bi shud+dhe bhan+dha dz+nyā na maṇ+ḍa la bh+rūm̐: lha bskyed pa ni: hūm̐: rgyu yi yi ge 'od 'phros 'dus pa las: ma chags pad+ma thabs shes nyi zla'i gdan: srin po ru dra brdzis pa'i gdan steng du: ma hā gu ru rdo rje drag po rtsal: rang rig rang byung rang shar gsal bar bsgom: pad+ma tsan+d+ra sūr+ya maṇ+ḍa ru dra ti ra na baṃ: hūm̐: sku mdog mthing nag 'jigs pa'i cha lugs la: phyag g.yas gnam lcags rdo rje rtse dgu bsnams: phyag g.yon gser gyi dril bu dku la brten: rin chen rus rgyan zab chen ber la sogs: mkha' 'gro dam can dbang sdud rgyan gyis brgyan: dur khrod chas brgyad brjid pa'i gar dgur ldan: sku gsung thugs dang yon tan phrin las kyi: lha tshogs thams cad nyid kyi sku la rdzogs: bde gshegs kun 'dus rdo rje drag po rtsal: zhabs gnyis gyad kyi 'gying bag stabs su bzhugs: de ba badz+ra hūm̐: hūm̐: spyi bo tshangs pa'i bu ga'i rtsa 'dab steng: mgon po tshe dpag med kyi lha tshogs rdzogs: oṃ badz+ra ā yu ṣe hūm̐ ā: klad pa dung khang rtsa yi 'khor lo la: 'jam dpal sku yi lha tshogs thams cad rdzogs: oṃ ya mān+ta ka hūm̐: mgrin pa longs spyod 'khor lo'i rtsa 'dab la: pad+ma gsung gi lha tshogs thams cad rdzogs:

oṃ ha ya grī wa hūm̐: snying ga chos kyi 'khor lo'i rtsa 'dab la: rdo rje thugs kyi lha tshogs thams cad rdzogs: oṃ badz+ra shrī he ru ka hūm̐: lte ba 'khor lo 'dus pa'i rtsa 'dab la: bdud rtsi yon tan lha tshogs thams cad rdzogs: oṃ sarba pañca a mṛta hūm̐: gsang gnas bde skyong 'khor lo'i rtsa 'dab la: che mchog ma mo'i lha tshogs thams cad rdzogs: oṃ shrī he ru ka hūm̐: ha he ma phaṭa bh+yo: rtsa chen rtsa phran stong gi 'khor lo la: mkha' 'gro 'bum phrag mang po'i lha tshogs rdzogs: ha ri ni sa hūm̐: dbu la rgyal ba rigs lngas dbang bskur mdzad: hūm̐ oṃ swā āṃḥhā: a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: sku ni rdo rje khros pa'i sku gsung thugs: oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭa: phyag g.yas gnam lcags rdo rje rtse dgu la: 'jigs byed khro bcu'i lha tshogs thams cad rdzogs: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: phyag g.yon gser gyi dril bu khro mo bcu: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: zhabs gnyis brkyang bskum ru dra brdzis pa la: phyogs skyong sde brgyad dregs pa'i srog rtsa 'dus: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: ya ma rā tsa du tri phu tri sarba trig nan: de nas spos dang bcas te gdung ba'i dbyangs kyis spyan drangs pa ni: hūm̐: sngon gyi bskal pa dang po la: o rgyan yul gyi nub byang mtshams: pad+ma ge sar sdong po la: ya mtshan mchog gi dngos grub brnyes: pad+ma 'byung gnas zhes su grags: 'khor du mkha' 'gro mang pos bskor: khyed kyi rjes su bdag sgrub kyis: byin gyis brlab phyir gshegs su gsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sa ma ya dzaḥdza: hūm̐: dha na ko ṣa'i mtsho gling du: drag po'i brtul zhugs mdzad pa'i tshe: sangs rgyas kun gyis dbang bskur mdzad: mkha' 'gro thams cad dbang du bsdus: rdo rje phag mo yum dang rol: lha srin sde brgyad bran du 'khol:

bdud dang log 'dren thams cad bsgral: gsang mtshan rdo rje drag po rtsal: rdo rje srin po'i lha tshogs rnams: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: oṃ badz+ra kro dha de wa sa ma ya dzaḥdzaḥ hūm̐: ma g.yel ma g.yel rig 'dzin tshogs: chos sku longs sku sprul sku yi: bla ma kun 'dus thod phreng rtsal: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: hūm̐: ma g.yel ma g.yel yi dam lha: sgrub chen bka' brgyad lha tshogs kyi: yi dam kun 'dus drag po rtsal: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: hūm̐: ma g.yel ma g.yel dam can tshogs: mkha' 'gro ging dang bka' nyan rnams: sngon gyi dam tshig rjes dgongs la: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: gu ru dhe wa ḍā ki nī: badz+ra sa ma ya dza dza: hūm̐: bzhengs shig pad+ma 'byung gnas mkha' 'gro'i tshogs: dgongs shig phyogs bcu dus gsum bde gshegs rnams: rje btsun chen po pad+ma thod phreng rtsal: rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro'i gnas nas gshegs su gsol: dbu skra mdzes pa'i thor cog shigs se shig: rin chen rgyan cha mang po si li li: dur khrod rus pa'i rgyan cha khro lo lo: sgra dang rol mo mang po 'u ru ru: yi dam lha tshogs hūm̐ sgra di ri ri: mkha' 'gro sde lngas gar byed shigs se shig: ging chen dpa' bos bro brdung khrabs se khrab: ma mo mkha' 'gro sprin ltar thibs se thib: phyogs skyong sde brgyad las byed khyugs se khyug: zhub chen stong gi sgra skad si li li: g.yas na pho rgyud thams cad sha ra ra: g.yon na mo rgyud thams cad sha ra ra: bar snang thams cad dar gdugs lhabs se lhab: dri zhim spos kyi ngad pa thu lu lu: mkha' 'gro gsang ba'i brda skad di ri ri: ging chen dpa' bo'i bshug glu kyu ru ru: hūm̐ gi snang glu mang po di ri ri: phaṭa kyi brda skad drag po sangs se sang: bdag dang 'gro drug sems can thams cad la: thugs rjes gzigs la gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol:

gnas 'dir thugs rjes dgongs te gshegs nas kyang: bdag gis byang chub snying po ma thob bar: bgegs dang log 'dren bar chad 'dul ba dang: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub bstsal du gsol: oṃ e h+ye hi: bha ga wān ma hā kā ru ṇi kā dṛ sh+ya ho: sa ma ya ho: sa ma ya s+t+waṃ: dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho: hūm̐: pad+ma nyi zla ru dra'i gdan steng du: ma hā gu ru rdo rje drag po rtsal: rang rig rang shar zhi khro rtsa ba'i lha: mi g.yo dgyes shing brtan par bzhugs su gsol: phyag 'tshal ba ni: hūm̐: skye 'gag 'gyur med phrin las thams cad rdzogs: rang byung thugs rjes 'gro drug sgrol bar mdzad: yid bzhin nor bu'i dngos grub char ltar 'beb: rdo rje drag po rtsal la phyag 'tshal bstod: a ti pū ho: pra tīts+tsha ho: de nas mchod pa 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro la: lha rdzas phyi mchod 'bul ba ni: ar+ghaṃ bdug spos me tog dang: mar me dri chab zhal zas dang: snyan pa'i rol mo mchod pa 'bul: oṃ ā ha ra ā ha ra: sarba bid+yā dha ra pū dzi te āḥhūm̐: oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe trāṃ: dhū pe hūm̐: ā lo ke hrī: gan+dhe ā: nai wid+ya hūm̐: shab+da ā: hūm̐: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro la: rang byung nang mchod 'bul ba ni: dbang po lnga yi me tog mchod: tshil chen dud pa'i dri yis mchod: zhun chen snang gsal mar mes mchod: rdo rje dri chu'i byug pas mchod: bdud rtsi dri chen zhal zas mchod: rkang gling thod rnga sgra yis mchod: dug gsum sku gsung thugs su mchod: dug lnga ye shes lnga ru mchod: snang srid phyag rgya bzhi ru mchod: mchod bzhes dbang dang dngos grub stsol: ma hā māṃ sa khā hi: ma hā tsit+ta khā hi: ma hā sarba pañca a mṛta khā hi: hūm̐: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro la: gnyis med gsang mchod 'bul ba ni: yab yum gnyis med mkha' gsang la: byang sems dkar dmar bde ba'i mchog: bde ba chen po'i mchod pa 'bul: sku lus rgyas phyir bzhes su gsol:

sa ma ya ho: sa ma ya s+t+waṃ: rā ga yā mi: ra ho haṃ: bo dhi tsit+ta hūm̐: hūm̐: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro la: drag po'i bsgral mchod 'bul ba ni: che mchog pad+ma thod phreng rtsal: phyag g.yas rdo rje rtse lnga gdengs: g.yon pas phur pa dgra snying gzir: gnod byed pho mo rdul du rlog: dgra bgegs sha rus mchod par bzhes: nṛ tri sarba mā ra ya rbad: ma hā māṃ sa khā hi: ma hā rak+ta khā hi: ma hā tsit+ta khā hi: ma hā kiṃ ni ri ti khā hi: hūm̐: rang byung gdod nas rnam par dag: rtsa ba brgyad la yan lag stong: bdud rtsi sman gyi mchod pa 'di: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro dang: dam can chos skyong rnams la 'bul: sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub stsol: ma hā sarba pañca a mṛta khā hi: hūm̐: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro la: rgyud drug bsgral ba'i rak+ta 'di: 'dod chags rtsad nas bcad pa'i phyir: skye med don gyi mchod pa bzhes: ma hā rak+ta khā hi: hūm̐: bla med mchog gi mchod pa dam pa sbyar ba 'di: ye shes lnga yi 'od zer rnam par 'phro: 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga yis rab brgyan te: thugs dam bzhin las ci bder bzhes su gsol: ma hā ba liṃ ta khā hi:

las can 'di dang 'phrad pa rnams: dkyil 'khor gsum po gsal btab la: nyin mtshan dus drug thams cad du: bsnyen pa chu bo'i gzhung bzhin bzla: dam rdzas phyi nang gsang ba'i rdzas: dngos 'byor yid kyis rnam sprul te: dus dang gza' skar bzang po la: thugs sgrub hūm̐ gi phrin las 'di: bla ma mchod phyir rgyun du 'bul: rtags dang don gyi bstod pa ni: 'dzab bsnyen phrin las dus su 'bul: hūm̐: dur khrod chen po rab tu 'jigs pa'i tshal: nyon mongs 'joms mdzad me dpung 'bar ba'i klong: chags med pad+ma thabs shes nyi zla'i gdan: dregs pa srin po brdzis pa'i gdan steng du: 'jigs byed chen po rdo rje drag po rtsal: sku mdog mthing nag 'bar ba'i gar dgur ldan: spyan bgrad mche gtsigs ag tshom me ltar 'bar: gyad kyi stangs stabs 'gying bag stabs su bzhugs: dbu skra'i thor tshugs na bza' sprin ltar gtibs: rigs lnga'i sangs rgyas rnams kyis dbu la brgyan: rin chen 'bar bas dbu dang phyag zhabs spras: phyag g.yas gnam lcags rdo rje rtse dgu 'phyar: phyag g.yon gser gyi dril bu dku la brten: dur khrod chas brgyad sku la legs par brgyan: zab chen ber smug dbang gi na bza' gsol: rus pa'i rgyan drug rtags kyis mdzes par brgyan: bde bar gshegs pa thams cad sku gsung thugs: mkha' 'gro 'bum phrag mang po'i ded dpon mdzad: rdo rje drag po rtsal la phyag 'tshal bstod: de nas hūm̐ gi 'dzab dbyangs bya ba ni: hūm̐: chos kyi dbyings kyi zhing khams su: kun bzang che mchog he ru ka: 'gro ba'i don du skur bzhengs la: chos nyid stong pa'i rang sgra sgrogs: bdag kyang khyed kyi rjes su 'jug: rig 'dzin bla mas byin gyis rlobs mdzod cig: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: rang byung rnam dag gzhal yas su: ye shes lnga ldan rgyal ba lnga: lcang lo can gyi gnas mchog tu: gsang bdag phyag na rdo rje yang: byang chub sems kyi gzhal yas su:

smug nag dbang gi mkha' 'gro yang: 'gro ba'i don du skur bzhengs la: chos nyid stong pa'i rang sgra sgrogs: bdag kyang khyed kyi rjes su 'jug: rig 'dzin bla mas byin gyis rlobs mdzod cig: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: ri rgyal lhun po'i rtse mo ru: tshangs pa'i rgyal po gdong gsum yang: rnam par rgyal ba'i khang bzang du: rig 'dzin lha dbang brgya byin yang: sin+dhu rgya mtsho'i mtsho gling du: rig 'dzin klu rgyal 'jog po yang: 'gro ba'i sogs 'gre / ma la ya'i gnam lcags rtse mo ru: bsod nams bsags pa'i rgyal po dza: za hor yul gyi gnas mchog tu: mkhas pa shākya pra bhā yang: yang le shod kyi brag phug tu: rig 'dzin pad+ma 'byung gnas kyang: 'gro ba'i sogs/ chu bo gang gā'i rtsa ba ru: mkhas pa bi ma mi tra yang: ma bal nags kyi rtsa ba ru: bal po shī la mañju yang: mon kha seng ge'i yang rdzong du: mkhar chen bza' yi mtsho rgyal yang: 'gro ba'i sogs/ rong gi brag dmar ke'u tshang du: sna nam rdo rje bdud 'joms kyang: ri rgyal bkra bzang shar 'dabs su: gter ston rig 'dzin yab sras kyang: thugs rje 'gyur med gzhal yas su: dran mchog rdo rje'i mtshan can yang: 'gro ba'i sogs/ mkha' spyod dag pa'i zhing khams su: sngags 'chang rdo rje mgon po yang: shrī byang rdzong sgrub khang du: mtshan ldan byams pa bshes gnyen yang: rdo rje phur pa'i gzhal yas su: mtshan ldan ngag dbang grags pa yang: 'gro ba'i don du skur bzhengs la: chos nyid stong pa'i rang sgra sgrogs: bdag kyang khyed kyi rjes su 'jug: rig 'dzin bla mas byin gyis rlobs mdzod cig: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: skya bo kha gdangs gnas mchog tu: chos rje sangs rgyas dpal bzang yang: bde grol gsang sngags chos gling du: thugs sras nam mkha' rgyal mtshan yang: yol mo gangs kyi ra ba ru: sngags 'chang shākya bzang po yang: 'gro ba'i sogs/ chu bo ri yi gnas mchog tu:

rig 'dzin bdud 'joms rdo rje yang: pad+ma'i e waṃ lcog sgar du: chos rgyal dbang po'i sde nyid kyang: mi 'gyur rdo rje'i bsti gnas su: rig 'dzin ngag gi dbang po yang: 'gro ba'i sogs/ mu tig shel gyi nags khrod du: rig 'dzin stobs ldan dbang po yang: 'bral med snying ga'i pho brang du: drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma yang: 'gro ba'i sogs/ rang lus rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor du: rang rig ma hā gu ru yang: gter mdzod bse sgrom smug po nas: gsang sngags snying po'i mthar thug kyang: smug nag gru gsum gzhal yas su: bka' srung e ka dzā ṭī yang: 'gro ba'i sogs/ rtsa dang thig le'i gzhal yas su: ma dang ye shes mkha' 'gro yang: bka' dang dam tshig gzhal yas su: bka' srung chos skyong gter bdag kyang: dam tshig gtsang ma'i gzhal yas su: mched lcam rdo rje spun grogs kyang: 'gro ba'i don du skur bzhengs la: chos nyid stong pa'i rang sgra sgrogs: bdag kyang khyed kyi rjes su 'jug: rig 'dzin bla mas byin gyis rlobs mdzod cig: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: lus la bde ba byin gyis rlobs: ngag la nus pa byin gyis rlobs: sems la rtogs pa byin gyis rlobs: lus ngag yid gsum la byin gyis rlobs mdzod cig: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: phyi yi bar chad phyi ru sol: nang gi bar chad nang du sol: gsang ba'i bar chad dbyings su sol: phyi nang gsang gsum gyi bar chad sol mdzod cig: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: mi mthun rkyen dang bar chad sol: mthun pa'i lam sna chos la drongs: mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub stsol mdzod cig: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: nā nā kha dhe sid+dhi hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ sarba sid+dhi dha naṃ mai dhīḥhrīḥ.ā yuḥsid+dhi sa ma ya sdus sdus: hūm̐: skye 'gag med pa chos kyi dbyings kyi ngang: 'du 'bral med pa bde chen pho brang du:

rang byung rang gsal thugs rje chen po'i sku: bde gshegs kun 'dus rdo rje drag po rtsal: rang rig lha yi lha la phyag 'tshal bstod: gsal 'grib med pa bde ba chen po'i sku: rig pa'i rang mdangs ma 'gag gsal ba la: rtsol sgrub bral bas bya byed gol sa chod: ma bcos rang shar 'dzin med spros dang bral: rig pa rang gsal ngang la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: rig pa'i cho 'phrul cir yang snang ba la: rgya chad phyogs lhung med pas 'khrul pa bral: cir snang 'dzin med grol bas bde ba che: gsal 'tsher dwangs pa skyon bral rig pa'i mdangs: longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: 'byung ba bzhi la brten pa'i phung po la: bcings 'thums sdug pa med par phyogs bcur 'tsher: gang shar rtag chad bral ba'i zang thal la: 'khrul pa'i ngar gsos mi gdab rang sar bzhag: rang byung sprul pa'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: rang rig dngos 'dzin kha dog ma grub par: snang stong phyogs lhung ye nas bral ba la: ma 'gag gsal 'tsher dwangs pa chos nyid ngang: rang rig ngo bo ma bcos thod phreng rtsal: rang rig bla ma'i mchog la phyag 'tshal bstod: 'di ltar hūm̐ gi phrin las zab mo ni: las can bu dang 'phrad nas sgrub pa'i tshe: gsang sngags zab mo tshig dang don du bsdeb: mtshams gcod bshags pa byin 'bebs gsum gyi dbyangs: nam mkha'i 'brug ltar bsgrags la gdangs dang ldan: spyan 'dren mchod 'bul bstod pa gsum gyi dbyangs: snyan la gdangs chags dril bu'i sgra ltar brjod: ting 'dzin rnam gsum la sogs gzhung gi dbyangs: nam mkha' dwangs pa'i klong ltar gting zab gsal: lhag ma la sogs mjug gi cho ga rnams: rgyal po'i bka' ltar gsal la brjid chags pa: thugs sgrub drag po'i sku gsung thugs kyi bcud: nam mkha' lta bu'i rdo rje sgrub pa'i skor: las can dam tshig can dang 'phrad par shog: de nas tshogs bya ba ni: raṃ yaṃ khaṃ trāṃ hūm̐: oṃ āḥhūm̐:

hūm̐: tshogs kyi yo byad thams cad kun: rnam rtog dngos 'dzin bag chags sbyangs: rat+na'i snod la bdud rtsi'i bcud: 'dod yon lha mo sprin ltar gtibs: hūm̐: rje btsun pad+ma thod phreng rtsal: gdung ba drag pos bdag gdungs shing: mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang bcas pa la: 'dod yon lnga ldan mchod pa 'bul: ba liṃ rgyan gyi mchod pa 'bul: bdud rtsi sman gyi mchod pa 'bul: rak+ta dmar gyi mchod pa 'bul: zhal zas tshogs kyi mchod pa 'bul: ting 'dzin rtse gcig mchod pa 'bul: sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub stsol: oṃ badz+ra gu ru de wa ḍā ki nī ma hā ba liṃ ta khā hi: sarba pañca a mṛta khā hi: rak+ta khā hi: hūm̐: snang ba snod kyi 'jig rten gtor gzhong du: srid pa bcud kyi sems can gtor mar bshams: dpal gyi gtor ma brjid ldan 'bar ba 'di: ri rab lhun po bas kyang dpang re mtho: ma mo'i gtor ma pad+mas bskor ba 'di: gling bzhi gling phran bas kyang bkod re legs: dkar gyi thig btab dmar gyi gur phub pa: gser gyi ri bdun bas kyang brjid re che: bdud rtsi sman gyi mchod pa dam pa 'di: lha yi zhal zas bas kyang ro re bda': rak+ta dmar gyi ar+ghaṃ 'khyil pa 'di: rgya mtsho mching snam bas kyang rgya re che: dkar rtsi dmar rtsi sha chen dri chen dang: dri chu mchod pa'i rdzas te rnam pa lnga: seng ge glang chen rta dang rma bya khyung: mchog chen mi la sogs te rnam pa lnga: ma hā māṃ sa la sogs sha sna stong: ma hā tsit+ta la sogs snying sna stong: ba su ta dang nang khrol rnam pa lnga: dbang po lnga dang go ro tsa na dang: shing thog me tog 'bru sna sman sna dang: mngar dang khur ba thug pa'i bye brag dang: mar thud phrum dang zho dang 'o ma dang: rtsi dang tsā ru rtsi chen go snyod dang: lga dang lan tshwa spod kyi bre brag dang: ri sgog klung sgog sha mo sna tshogs dang: ram bu rug pa sha mo sna tshogs dang: bza' dang bca' dang btung ba'i bye brag dang:

gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya chos la sogs: 'dod yon lnga yi mchod pa thams cad kun: thogs med blo yi sems kyis kun bsdus nas: ting 'dzin dgongs brgyud dag pas byin brlabs te: bdud rtsir sbyar ba'i mchod pa chen po 'dis: rdo rje slob dpon thugs dam bskang gyur cig: yi dam lha tshogs thugs dam bskang gyur cig: ma mo mkha' 'gro'ithugs dam bskang gyur cig: dam can srung ma'i thugs dam bskang gyur cig: ma hā ba liṃ ta khā hi: de nas rtsa gsum skong gso bya: de nas rang nyid tshogs la rol: lhag ma lha ru gsal bas kha chus bran la: lhag ma gtang ba ni: oṃ badz+ra ḍā ki nī hūm̐ dza: bud+dha= rat+na= pad+ma= karma= hūm̐: sngon tshe khrag 'thung he ru ka'i: spyan sngar khas blangs dam bcas dang: bar du pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi: spyan sngar khas blangs dam bcas pa: da lta rig 'dzin bdag nyid kyi: bran dang pho nyar khas blangs pa'i: sgrub sde brgyad kyi bka' srung dang: gsang sngags theg pa'i bka' srung rnams: bka' yi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: sngon gyi dam tshig dran par gyis: gsang sngags bstan pa rgyas par mdzod: bdud dang dam sri rdul du rlog: bcol pa'i phrin las grub par mdzod: oṃ badz+ra ḍā ki nī khā hi: bud+dha= rat+na= pad+ma= karma= oṃ uts+tshiṣ+ṭa ba liṃ ta bhak+ṣa bh+yaḥswā hā: de nas chad mdo bya ba ni: hūm̐: sngon gyi bskal pa dang po 'das pa'i dus: 'og min dga' ldan zhes bya'i gnas mchog tu: bcom ldan dpal chen khrag 'thung chen po yis: snang srid ma mo dam la btags pa'i tshe: ke'u ri la sogs gnas kyi khro mo brgyad: siṃ ha la sogs yul gyi phra men brgyad: rta gdong la sogs sgo ma bzhi rnams kyis: so so'i gzugs mchog dam pa bstan nas kyang: bka' yi gtor ma len par ma chad dam: rnal 'byor tshe srog bsring bar ma chad dam: bcol ba'i phrin las sgrub par ma chad dam: sngon tshe zhal bzhes dam las ma 'da' bar: dpal chen bka' yi gtor ma 'di bzhes la:

bdag gis bcol ba'i phrin las grub par mdzod: hūm̐: bskal pa bar ma gsang sngags dar ba'i dus: bal yul yang le shod kyi brag phug tu: slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas dang: las can bal mo shākya de wa yis: rdo rje dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor zhal phyes tshe: gtsang ris dpal mgon bdun cu rtsa lnga yis: so so'i gzugs mchog dam pa bstan nas kyang: bka' yi gtor ma len par ma chad dam: rnal 'byor tshe srog bsring bar ma chad dam: bcol ba'i phrin las sgrub par ma chad dam: sngon tshe zhal bzhes dam las ma 'da' bar: slob dpon bdag gis bcol ba'i phrin las mdzod: de 'og bskal pa tha ma bod kyi yul: bsam yas mchims phu'i brag dmar ke'u tshang du: slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas dang: mnga' bdag rgyal po la sogs grub chen brgyad: sgrub pa bka' brgyad dkyil 'khor zhal phyes tshe: bka' yi srung ma dregs pa sde brgyad kyis: so so'i gzugs mchog dam pa bstan nas kyang: bka' yi gtor ma len par ma chad dam: rnal 'byor tshe srog bsring bar ma chad dam: bcol ba'i phrin las sgrub par ma chad dam: sngon tshe zhal bzhes dam las ma 'da' bar: dam tshig bka' yi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: bdag gis bcol ba'i phrin las grub par mdzod: de nas brtan ma bskyang ba ni: hūm̐: a su ra yi brag phug tu: o rgyan pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi: spyan sngar khas blangs dam bcas pa'i: bod yul brtan ma bcu gnyis dang: phyi gtor dbang bar khas blangs rnams: mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la: bdud dpung thul la zhing bcu sgrol: dal kha chings la 'bru bcud spel: dmag dpung choms la mtshon rtse rtul: bcol ba'i phrin las grub par mdzod: ma mā: kha khā: la lā: le lai: ta ta: te tā+ai: māṃ sa rak+ta: pañca a mṛta khā hi: de nas dngos grub blang ba ni: hūm̐: bstan pa 'di la ngo mtshar rmad byung ba'i: 'jig rten skyabs gyur pad+ma rgyal po ni: rigs ni za hor rgyal po'i sras su 'khrungs:

o rgyan yul du sgro 'dogs ma lus bcad: bsil ba tshal du dngos grub thams cad brnyes: kha ba can du bstan pa rgyas par mdzad: lho nub mtshams su srin po'i kha gnon mdzad: mya ngan mi 'da' 'gro ba'i gnyen gcig pu: sku gsum che mchog badz+ra he ru ka: mnyam med bla ma mchog de dus 'dir dran: 'dir gshegs rgyan gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor bcas la: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub zhu lags so: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūm̐: hūm̐: shar gyi phyogs nas dngos grub skul ba'i lha: zhi ba'i las mdzad rdo rje thod phreng rtsal: zhi ba'i rang bzhin sku mdog dkar la 'tsher: na bza' dkar po shin tu mdzes par gsol: phyag mtshan rdo rje lcags kyu ḍā ma ru: rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i thugs dam rgyud bskul nas: bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor bcas la: nad gdon bar chad sdig sgrib zhi ba'i dngos grub zhu lags so: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūm̐: hūm̐: lho yi phyogs nas dngos grub skul ba'i lha: rgyas pa'i las mdzad rat+na thod phreng rtsal: rgyas pa'i rang bzhin sku mdog ser la 'tsher: na bza' ser po shin tu mdzes par gsol: phyag mtshan rin chen zhags pa ḍā ma ru: rin chen mkha' 'gro'i thugs dam rgyud bskul nas: tshe dang bsod nams rgyas pa'i dngos grub zhu lags so: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūm̐: hūm̐: nub kyi phyogs nas dngos grub skul ba'i lha: dbang gi las mdzad pad+ma thod phreng rtsal: dbang gi rang bzhin sku mdog dmar la 'tsher: na bza' dmar po shin tu mdzes par gsol: phyag mtshan pad+ma lcags sgrog ḍā ma ru: pad+ma mkha' 'gro'i thugs dam rgyud bskul nas: bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor bcas la: khams gsum dbang sdud kyi dngos grub zhu lags so: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūm̐: hūm̐: byang gi phyogs nas dngos grub skul ba'i lha:

drag po'i las mdzad karma thod phreng rtsal: drag po'i rang bzhin sku mdog ljang la 'tsher: na bza' ljang gu shin tu mdzes par gsol: phyag mtshan rgya gram dril bu ḍā ma ru: las kyi mkha' 'gro'i thugs dam rgyud bskul nas: bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor bcas la: dgra bgegs tshar gcod kyi dngos grub zhu lags so: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūm̐: hūm̐: dbus kyi phyogs nas dngos grub skul ba'i lha: sku lnga lhun grub bud+dha thod phreng rtsal: lhun grub rang bzhin sku mdog smug la 'tsher: na bza' smug po shin tu mdzes par gsol: phyag mtshan 'khor lo dril bu ḍā ma ru: sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro'i thugs dam rgyud bskul nas: bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor bcas la: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub zhu lags so: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūm̐: nā nā kha dhe sarba sid+dhi hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: sarba sid+dhi dha naṃ me dhīḥhrīḥ.a yu sid+dhi sa ma ya sdus sdus:

dngos grub skul ba'i cho ga'o: de nas dkyil 'khor bsdu ba ni: hūm̐: da ni dkyil 'khor gsal btab la: phyi nang snod bcud thams cad kun: yig 'bru hūm̐ la hril gyis bsdu: hūm̐ yang mi dmigs 'ja' ltar yal: de nas bdag nyid lha ru gsal: rtag chad gnyis kyi mtha' bsal lo: thugs sgrub hūm̐ gi phrin las 'di: ma 'ongs lnga brgya'i snyigs ma la: las can bu dang 'phrad par shog: thugs sgrub drag po hūm̐ gi phrin las 'di: rgyas par byed na tshig dang don du bsdeb: bsdus pa byed na rang gzhung so sor bya: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: brag ri sbrul gdug spungs 'dra'i sked/ lho gser mdzod ser po nas/ rig 'dzin rgod kyi ldem 'phru can gyis bton pa'o// //
